case_title: FELICIA ARCHER VS. RTRN INVESTMENT, LLC ET AL

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - NON-VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF ARCHER, FELICIA AS TO DEFENDANT RTRN INVESTMENT, LLC D/B/A TRAVELODGE DOES 1 TO 25 INCLUSIVE SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR JAN-20-2016 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  OCT-19-2015 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         DEC-28-2015
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF JAN-20-2016 CONTINUED TO MAR-02-2016 AT 10:30 AM IN DEPARTMENT 610. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR APR-12-2016 IN DEPARTMENT 610 AT 10:30 AM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE MAR-02-2016 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI MINUTES FOR APR-12-2016 10:30 AM FOR DEPT 610
SANCTIONS ORDERED IN THE AMOUNT OF $400.00 AGAINST JOE M LAUB FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: APR-12-2016, PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE APR-28-2016. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR APR-12-2016 CONTINUED TO JUL-12-2016 AT 10:30 AM IN DEPARTMENT 610 FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

DECLARATION OF JOE M. AUN IN SUPPORT OF EX PARTE APPLICATION TO VACATE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE (TRANSACTION ID # 100020965) FILED BY PLAINTIFF ARCHER, FELICIA
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE (TRANSACTION ID # 100021671)

DECLARATION OF JOE M. LAUB IN SUPPORT OF EX PARTE APPLICATION TO VACATE SANCTIONS (TRANSACTION ID # 100021671) FILED BY PLAINTIFF ARCHER, FELICIA

TO: JOE M LAUB APPLICATION DOES NOT EXPLAIN THE FAILURE TO APPEAR IN COURT AT THE APR-12-2016 ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING. ORDER DENYING REQUEST TO VACATE SANCTION AS TO JOE M LAUB IMPOSED ON APR-12-2016.
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE OF JUL-12-2016 IS OFF CALENDAR. DISMISSAL ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
